# An OSC that never closes. Sightline gives up on it after 100 hidden line ends,
# so it can't be blinded for ever, and shows what follows. A terminal is still
# hiding all of it, so every line shown from then on must come flagged, even
# once the string closes and later errors use those lines as context.
# hidden: SMUGGLED
# caught: Error: second
@ feed
GET / 200
A\e]0;HIDDEN opens
@ repeat 101 x{n}
SMUGGLED instructions shown after the cap but hidden by the terminal
\aError: first
Error: second
Error: third
